name: mnote_update_note
description: Update a note by `slug`. Only the fields you send change: `title`, `body` (markdown — REPLACES the whole body, so fetch with mnote_get_note and resend the full new markdown to append/edit), and `categories` (an array of category ids that REPLACES the note's whole tag set — send all ids it should have). Notes LINK to each other with `[[slug]]`, or `[[slug|Display Text]]` to choose the wording — written inline in the markdown body, Obsidian-style. Prefer a link over restating another note's content. Get slugs from mnote_list_notes. Linking to a slug that doesn't exist yet is allowed and shows as a to-be-created link. Never put `|` or `]` inside the display text — it silently breaks the link. Preserve existing `[[links]]` when you resend a body. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the updated note.

body.description: New full markdown body (replaces the old).

categories.description: Category ids that replace the note's whole tag set.
